name: foray-mobile
description: The native app shell (issue #36). Deliberately NOT at the repo root: the root is dependency-free with no build step, which is what lets the keyless GitHub Action deploy the static site from main's root — see the root package.json's own description and CLAUDE.md. Capacitor's node_modules and its build step live here and reach UP into the repo for the web files, so the web deploy path is untouched. Same pattern as tools/corpus/ and backend/.
//no-test-script: Intentional. tools/ci/run-suites.mjs scans player/, test/ and tools/ only, so no suite is ever discovered under mobile/ and this package is never installed by CI. The shell's own suites live in tools/mobile/, which since 2026-09-04 carries its own package.json (one devDependency: esbuild, the bundle's minifier) and is therefore its own runner group — CI installs it and runs the suites there, so the bundle CI measures is the bundle that ships. If SCANNED_DIRS is ever widened to include mobile/, the runner will hard-error on 'dependencies but no test script' — that is the loud failure it is designed to give, and the fix is to add a test script here, not to widen the scan quietly.
//webdir: www/ is a BUILD ARTEFACT, gitignored, rebuilt by ../tools/mobile/prepare-webdir.mjs. Never edit anything inside it; you would be editing a copy of the real site. The JS/CSS in it is minified (comments and whitespace only — every identifier is kept) and the JSON is written without indentation; the web keeps serving the commented source from the repo root.
//deps:webdir: prepare-webdir.mjs needs esbuild, which is a devDependency of ../tools/mobile/package.json (NOT of this package, and NOT of the root — see that file's description). `npm ci --prefix ../tools/mobile` installs exactly the locked version there, so every path that builds the bundle — a founder's Mac, ios-build.yml's `npm run add:ios`, android-build.yml's `npm run add:android` — gets the minifier without a separate step to remember. prepare-webdir.mjs refuses to build without it rather than quietly copying the source verbatim.

scripts.add:ios: npm run prepare:webdir && cap add ios
scripts.add:android: npm run prepare:webdir && cap add android

//foray-audio: NOT a third-party dependency. `file:plugins/foray-audio` is this repo's OWN hand-written Android code (a mediaPlayback foreground service), declared here because that is the only way Capacitor's CLI discovers a plugin: `@capacitor/cli`'s getDependencies() reads this object, resolvePlugin() looks for a `capacitor` key in the resolved package.json, and `cap sync` then writes the include/implementation lines into the GENERATED mobile/android/ on every run. That is what makes the native code survive a platform regeneration with nothing for a human to run. It adds no code from anyone else — npm links a directory that is already in this repo. See docs/android-native-code.md.
//foray-tts: Also NOT a third-party dependency, same mechanism as foray-audio above. `file:plugins/foray-tts` is this repo's own on-device TTS plugin (docs/research/on-device-tts.md): AVSpeechSynthesizer on iOS, android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech on Android, declared here so `cap sync` discovers both its iOS Package.swift and its Android Gradle module the same way it discovers foray-audio's.
